1.name: Welcome to Charmswell
1.overview: It's Sofia's first day of royal magic school, and she teams up with new friends to win a race and gets a magical visit from Rapunzel.

1.name: Abracadazzle
1.overview: Sofia joins a magical challenge against students from the other castles.

1.name: Show and Spell
1.overview: Layla tries a levitation spell but instead reveals her ability to sprout butterfly wings.

1.name: Give it a Twirl
1.overview: Sofia and Layla co-captain a magical parade, but they can't agree on anything.

1.name: The Tippity Tap Dance
1.overview: Zane uses magic to improve his dance moves but when the charm becomes a curse, Sofia helps solve it.

1.name: Magic Mayhem
1.overview: Camila wants to be Cedric's apprentice but causes chaos with advanced spells.

1.name: Royal Mix It Up
1.overview: Sofia is paired up with Zane's sister Zaria for a tri-castle activity, but they have nothing in common.

1.name: A Royal Family Picnic
1.overview: While on a family picnic, Amber wants to prove she's just as amazing as Sofia.

1.name: The Royal Playdate
1.overview: When Layla meets Sofia's siblings, Amber and James, she goes to extreme lengths to impress them.

1.name: New Horse on the Block
1.overview: Sofia and her new flying horse Wildfyre try out for the Charmswell Flying Derby.

1.name: The Green-Eyed Monster
1.overview: Wanting to be good at potions, Zane accidentally creates out-of-control Green-Eyed Goo Monsters.

1.name: Sleepy Time Spell
1.overview: At a sleepover at Sofia's castle with Camilla and Layla, stuffies magically come to life.

1.name: Zane the Hero
1.overview: A grumpy dragon is on the loose at Charmswell, and Zane tries to tame the bumbling beast.

1.name: Veggie Good Deed
1.overview: Wanting to do a good deed, Amber helps Sofia with the village feast but causes some magical problems instead.

1.name: The Lilygnome
1.overview: Sofia needs Layla's help to tame a mischievous magical flower.

1.name: Crown Chaos
1.overview: Sofia defends Charmswell Academy from the wicked sorceress, Zandrya, with help from Rapunzel.

1.name: Of to the Races
1.overview: Camila learns to be there for her friends during the school's flying derby race.

1.name: When Clover Met Pepper
1.overview: Clover meets Pepper when he visits Sofia's castle, and Clover worries Sofia has a new best pet friend.

1.name: A Wand-erful Day
1.overview: James accidentally breaks Sofia's wand and replaces it with a trick wand.

1.name: Kidding Around
1.overview: Sofia makes a wish that accidentally turns her mom into a kid.

1.name: Puppercorn Ruckus
1.overview: Sofia helps Camila during a class project when they are overwhelmed by adorable puppercorns.

1.name: The Enchanted Lake
1.overview: Zane accidentally loses Layla's treasured notebook in the Charmswell lake.

1.name: Tricky Trixie
1.overview: Camila lets a friendly troll borrow her wand, and the troll runs away with it.

1.name: Hallow's Eve Hijinks
1.overview: Zane releases a mischievous goblin to help win a Hallow's Eve decoration contest.

1.name: Costume Clash
1.overview: Lucinda the Witch and Camila spend All Hallow's Eve with Sofia.

overview: Follow Sofia as she attends The Charmswell School for Royal Magic, where she discovers she is the most magical princess in the realm and must learn how to master her powers while making new royal friends.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends — Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila — each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With Sofia as your guide, there's no better way to discover the magic of Charmswell!
